3	A modern, premium movie and TV streaming platform built with Next.js 15, featuring a cinematic dark UI, TMDB integration, and embos.top embed streaming.
4	
5	---
6	
7	## 🚀 Quick Start
8	
9	### 1. Install dependencies
10	```bash
11	npm install
12	```
13	
14	### 2. Configure environment
15	```bash
16	cp .env.example .env.local
17	```
18	
19	Edit `.env.local` and fill in:

21	| Variable | Description |
22	|---|---|
23	| `DATABASE_URL` | PostgreSQL connection string |
24	| `NEXTAUTH_SECRET` | Random secret (`openssl rand -base64 32`) |
25	| `NEXTAUTH_URL` | Your app URL (http://localhost:3000 for dev) |
26	| `TMDB_API_KEY` | From https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api |
27	| `TMDB_ACCESS_TOKEN` | Read Access Token from TMDB |
28	| `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` | From Google Cloud Console |
29	| `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET` | From Google Cloud Console |
30	| `DISCORD_CLIENT_ID` | From Discord Developer Portal |
31	| `DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET` | From Discord Developer Portal |
32	| `NEXT_PUBLIC_STREAM_BASE_URL` | `https://embos.top` |
33	
34	### 3. Set up database
35	```bash
36	npx prisma db push       # Push schema to database
37	npx prisma db seed       # Seed admin user
38	npx prisma generate      # Generate Prisma client
39	```

43	npm run dev

# 🎬 MovieShack

A modern, premium movie and TV streaming platform built with Next.js 15, featuring a cinematic dark UI, TMDB integration, and embos.top embed streaming.

---

## 🚀 Quick Start

### 1. Install dependencies
```bash
npm install
```

### 2. Configure environment
```bash
cp .env.example .env.local
```

Edit `.env.local` and fill in:

| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` | PostgreSQL connection string |
| `NEXTAUTH_SECRET` | Random secret (`openssl rand -base64 32`) |
| `NEXTAUTH_URL` | Your app URL (http://localhost:3000 for dev) |
| `TMDB_API_KEY` | From https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api |
| `TMDB_ACCESS_TOKEN` | Read Access Token from TMDB |
| `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` | From Google Cloud Console |
| `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET` | From Google Cloud Console |
| `DISCORD_CLIENT_ID` | From Discord Developer Portal |
| `DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET` | From Discord Developer Portal |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_STREAM_BASE_URL` | `https://embos.top` |

### 3. Set up database
```bash
npx prisma db push       # Push schema to database
npx prisma db seed       # Seed admin user
npx prisma generate      # Generate Prisma client
```

### 4. Run development server
```bash
npm run dev
```

Open http://localhost:3000

---

## 📁 Project Structure

```
src/
├── app/                    # Next.js App Router pages
│   ├── page.tsx            # Homepage (all sections)
│   ├── movie/[id]/         # Movie detail page
│   ├── tv/[id]/            # TV show page with episodes
│   ├── actor/[id]/         # Actor/person page
│   ├── search/             # Search page with filters
│   ├── browse/             # Browse pages (movies, TV, genre)
│   ├── watchlist/          # Watchlist & history
│   ├── profile/            # User profile
│   ├── admin/              # Admin dashboard
│   ├── request/            # Content request page
│   ├── auth/               # Sign in / Sign up
│   └── api/                # API routes
│       ├── auth/           # NextAuth handler + register
│       ├── tmdb/search/    # TMDB search proxy
│       ├── comments/       # Comments CRUD + likes
│       ├── watchlist/      # Watchlist management
│       ├── requests/       # Content requests
│       └── user/           # Progress, likes, history
├── components/
│   ├── layout/             # Navbar, Footer
│   ├── home/               # HeroBanner, ContinueWatching
│   ├── common/             # MediaCard, MediaRow, Skeletons, Comments
│   ├── movie/              # MoviePlayer, CastSection
│   ├── tv/                 # TVPlayer, SeasonEpisodeSelector
│   ├── search/             # SearchModal
│   ├── watchlist/          # WatchlistActions
│   └── ui/                 # Toaster
├── lib/
│   ├── tmdb/client.ts      # TMDB API client + all endpoints
│   ├── auth/index.ts       # NextAuth config
│   ├── db/index.ts         # Prisma singleton
│   └── utils/index.ts      # Helpers (cn, formatters, etc.)
├── hooks/
│   ├── use-debounce.ts
│   ├── use-watchlist.ts
│   └── index.ts            # All other hooks
├── store/index.ts          # Zustand stores
├── types/index.ts          # TypeScript types
└── styles/globals.css      # Global CSS + design tokens
```

---

## 🎨 Design System

The design uses a custom dark cinema palette defined in `tailwind.config.js`:

| Token | Value | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| `sv-bg` | `#0a0a10` | Page background |
| `sv-surface` | `#111118` | Surface layer |
| `sv-elevated` | `#1a1a24` | Cards, elevated UI |
| `sv-accent` | `#7c5cfc` | Primary actions, highlights |
| `sv-gold` | `#f5c842` | Star ratings |
| `sv-green` | `#2ed573` | Success, watched state |
| `sv-red` | `#ff4757` | Danger, likes |

---

## 🔑 OAuth Setup

### Google
1. Go to https://console.cloud.google.com
2. Create project → APIs & Services → Credentials
3. Create OAuth 2.0 Client ID (Web application)
4. Add `http://localhost:3000/api/auth/callback/google` to redirect URIs

### Discord
1. Go to https://discord.com/developers/applications
2. New Application → OAuth2
3. Add redirect: `http://localhost:3000/api/auth/callback/discord`
4. Copy Client ID and Secret

---

## 🗄️ Database

Uses PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM.

**Tables:**
- `users` — User accounts
- `accounts`, `sessions` — NextAuth OAuth
- `watch_history` — Titles watched
- `view_progress` — Resume positions
- `watchlist_items` — Saved titles
- `custom_lists` — User-created lists
- `comments`, `comment_likes` — Community
- `content_likes` — Likes on movies/shows
- `content_requests` — User requests
- `reports` — Content reports
- `content_views` — Analytics

---

## 🌊 Streaming

Streaming uses **embos.top** embeds via `<iframe>`.

URLs are built as:
- Movies: `https://embos.top/movie/{tmdbId}`
- TV: `https://embos.top/tv/{tmdbId}/{season}/{episode}`

Change `NEXT_PUBLIC_STREAM_BASE_URL` in `.env.local` to switch providers.

---

## 🚢 Deployment (Vercel)

```bash
# Install Vercel CLI
npm i -g vercel

# Deploy
vercel

# Set environment variables in Vercel dashboard or:
vercel env add DATABASE_URL
```

**Important:** Use a managed PostgreSQL like:
- [Neon](https://neon.tech) (free tier)
- [Supabase](https://supabase.com)
- [Railway](https://railway.app)

---

## 📝 Key Commands

```bash
npm run dev          # Start dev server
npm run build        # Build for production
npm run start        # Start production server
npm run db:push      # Push schema changes
npm run db:migrate   # Run migrations
npm run db:studio    # Open Prisma Studio
npm run db:seed      # Seed database
npm run lint         # Lint code
```

---

## ⚠️ Legal Disclaimer

This project does not host, store, or distribute any video content. All video is embedded from third-party services. You are responsible for ensuring your use complies with applicable laws in your jurisdiction.

---

## 📄 License
